title: Verify UI trace outcomes across control channels
changes: Record a bounded DBG2-13 menu, CLI and console parity check for UI trace start, duplicate refusal and report.
validation: In isolated Wine/Xvfb interpreter copies, each of direct local-control CLI, menu and integrated command console started a UI trace, refused a second start while active, and saved a report. CLI and console returned identical refusal text; the menu displayed it. Parent state, frame and clock, original inputs and pins remained unchanged; sessions and displays closed.

The first helper read a nonexistent report field after the CLI had succeeded; the next helper completed the menu path but failed to navigate to the console. Both copies closed normally, and a third copy completed only the missing console path.
limitations: Trace contents differ because the user interactions differ; this checks action and validation outcomes, not byte-identical reports, all operations, native Windows or physical input.
